subject: IT
question: Which part of the computer is called its brain?
explanation: CPU ko computer ka dimagh kaha jata hai — woh tamam instructions ko process karta hai.
explanationEn: The CPU is called the brain of the computer — it processes all the instructions.

subject: IT
question: Which memory is temporary and loses its data when the computer is switched off?
explanation: RAM temporary memory hai — computer band hotay hi is ka data khatam ho jata hai.
explanationEn: RAM is temporary memory — as soon as the computer is switched off, its data is lost.

subject: IT
question: Which memory permanently stores the basic instructions needed to start a computer?
explanation: ROM permanent memory hai — is mein computer ko start karnay ki zaroori instructions mehfooz hoti hain.
explanationEn: ROM is permanent memory — it stores the instructions needed to start the computer.

subject: IT
question: Which of these is an input device?
explanation: Keyboard input device hai — is se hum computer mein likh kar data daaltay hain.
explanationEn: A keyboard is an input device — we use it to enter data into the computer by typing.

subject: IT
question: Which device is used to point and click on the computer screen?
explanation: Mouse pointing device hai — is se hum screen par cursor ko harkat dete hain aur click karte hain.
explanationEn: A mouse is a pointing device — we use it to move the cursor on the screen and to click.

subject: IT
question: Which of these is an output device?
explanation: Monitor output device hai — is par computer ka result aur tasveerain nazar aati hain.
explanationEn: A monitor is an output device — the computer's results and images appear on it.

subject: IT
question: In which part is data stored permanently in a computer?
explanation: Hard disk mein data mustaqil mehfooz rehta hai — computer band honay ke baad bhi data nahi mita.
explanationEn: Data stays stored permanently on a hard disk — it is not erased even after the computer is switched off.

subject: IT
question: How many bits are there in 1 byte?
explanation: 1 byte mein 8 bits hotay hain.
explanationEn: There are 8 bits in 1 byte.

subject: IT
question: How many bytes are there in 1 kilobyte (KB)?
explanation: 1 kilobyte (KB) mein 1024 bytes hotay hain.
explanationEn: There are 1024 bytes in 1 kilobyte (KB).

subject: IT
question: Which is the largest storage unit among these?
explanation: TB (terabyte) in mein sab se bara hai — 1 TB mein 1024 GB hotay hain.
explanationEn: The terabyte (TB) is the largest of these — 1 TB has 1024 GB.

subject: IT
question: What is the file extension of a Microsoft Word document?
explanation: .docx MS Word ki file ka extension hai.
explanationEn: .docx is the file extension of an MS Word file.

subject: IT
question: What is the file extension of a Microsoft Excel file?
explanation: .xlsx MS Excel ki file ka extension hai.
explanationEn: .xlsx is the file extension of an MS Excel file.

subject: IT
question: What is the file extension of a Microsoft PowerPoint presentation?
explanation: .pptx MS PowerPoint ki presentation ka extension hai.
explanationEn: .pptx is the file extension of an MS PowerPoint presentation.

subject: IT
question: Which shortcut is used to save a file?
explanation: Ctrl+S dabane se file save hoti hai — kaam karte waqt waqtan fawaqtan save karna chahiye.
explanationEn: Pressing Ctrl+S saves the file — you should save from time to time while working.

subject: IT
question: Which shortcut is used to copy selected text?
explanation: Ctrl+C se selected text ya file copy hoti hai.
explanationEn: Ctrl+C copies the selected text or file.

subject: IT
question: Which shortcut is used to paste copied text?
explanation: Ctrl+V se copy ya cut ki hui cheez paste hoti hai.
explanationEn: Ctrl+V pastes the copied or cut item.

subject: IT
question: Which shortcut is used to cut selected text?
explanation: Ctrl+X se selected cheez cut hoti hai — woh apni purani jagah se hat jati hai.
explanationEn: Ctrl+X cuts the selected item — it is removed from its original place.

subject: IT
question: Which shortcut is used to undo the last action?
explanation: Ctrl+Z se aakhri kaam undo ho jata hai — ghalti ho jaye to is se wapas aa sakte hain.
explanationEn: Ctrl+Z undoes the last action — if you make a mistake, you can go back with it.

subject: IT
question: Which shortcut is used to print a document?
explanation: Ctrl+P dabane se print dialog khulta hai.
explanationEn: Pressing Ctrl+P opens the print dialog.

subject: IT
question: Which shortcut is used to switch between open windows?
explanation: Alt+Tab se aik khuli hui window se doosri window par switch karte hain.
explanationEn: Alt+Tab switches from one open window to another.

subject: IT
question: Which of these is an operating system?
explanation: Windows operating system hai — woh computer ke hardware aur software ko manage karta hai.
explanationEn: Windows is an operating system — it manages the computer's hardware and software.

subject: IT
question: Which Excel function is used to add a group of numbers?
explanation: Excel mein SUM function numbers ko jama (add) karta hai — jaisay =SUM(A1:A5).
explanationEn: In Excel, the SUM function adds numbers — for example, =SUM(A1:A5).

subject: IT
question: In MS Excel, every formula must begin with which symbol?
explanation: Excel mein har formula = ke nishan se shuru hota hai — jaisay =A1+B1.
explanationEn: In Excel, every formula begins with the = sign — for example, =A1+B1.

subject: IT
question: In MS Excel, the intersection of a row and a column is called:
explanation: Cell row aur column ke milne ki jagah hoti hai — jaisay B3 mein column B aur row 3 milte hain.
explanationEn: A cell is where a row and a column meet — for example, in B3, column B and row 3 meet.

subject: IT
question: A single page of a PowerPoint presentation is called a:
explanation: PowerPoint presentation ka aik page slide kehlata hai.
explanationEn: A single page of a PowerPoint presentation is called a slide.

subject: IT
question: What does WWW stand for?
explanation: WWW ka matlab World Wide Web hai — websites isi par chalti hain.
explanationEn: WWW stands for World Wide Web — websites run on it.

subject: IT
question: Which of these is a web browser?
explanation: Browser woh program hai jis se websites kholi jati hain — Google Chrome aik browser hai.
explanationEn: A browser is the program used to open websites — Google Chrome is a browser.

subject: IT
question: Which symbol must be present in every email address?
explanation: Email address mein @ ka nishan lazmi hota hai — jaisay name@example.com.
explanationEn: The @ symbol must be present in every email address — for example, name@example.com.

subject: IT
question: Which of these is a search engine?
explanation: Google aik search engine hai — is se hum internet par maloomat talash karte hain.
explanationEn: Google is a search engine — we use it to search for information on the internet.

subject: IT
question: Which software protects a computer from viruses?
explanation: Antivirus software computer ko virus aur nuqsan-deh programs se bachata hai.
explanationEn: Antivirus software protects a computer from viruses and harmful programs.
